_comment: Hand-verified facts the registers cannot express: documented delistings, identity matches for platform symbols the vendor no longer serves (name_match → the register ISIN), and lines that are share classes rather than companies. Every entry carries its evidence. The generator (scripts/egx-security-master.mjs) applies these AFTER the register match, never instead of it.

delisted.note: EGX published a Delisting Decree for Global Telecom Holding; shares delisted at the close of 9 Sep 2019 (VEON). Mubasher's market announcement of 11 Sep 2019 confirms. The 2026 prints TradingView relays under EGX:GTHE are off-board trades in a delisted security, not a listed EGX quote.
